overview_description.description: Lean Technologies is a FinTech startup that develops a platform to provide access to consumer financial data. The company's API suite, designed to abstract developers from the fragmentation of the financial infrastructure, enables businesses to seamlessly access their customers' financial data and initiate instant bank transfers. The company aims to enhance the accessibility, transparency, and utility of financial data and payments for consumers and businesses, promoting a more inclusive and interconnected financial landscape.

about_short_description.short_description: Lean Technologies is a fintech platform offering an API that powers financial products with essential data and payments tools.

product.name: Data Aggregation
product.description: Provides access to customers' bank account details, live balances, and transaction history in a standardized format.

product.name: Identity Verification
product.description: Captures and verifies customer identity data using bank account information.

product.name: Financial Insights
product.description: Enriches financial data with transaction categorization, income verification, and other analytical information.

product.name: Integrated Payments
product.description: Enables building a fully integrated payments flow for retail and corporate customers within a platform.

product.name: Payment Operations - Payouts
product.description: Collects, collates, and processes payout requests from end users across a platform.

product.name: Payment Operations - Reconciliation
product.description: Provides a dashboard to reconcile payments processed through Lean with bank accounts.
